description: Project title : PMACS-95   Grant Information:  AHA Grant 9TPA34910007, Regulatory role of pericardial macrophages in myocardial infarction   Relevant Citations:      https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2024.110244     Project Description:   · Animal Model: N/A – In Vitro Experiment using Mouse Cells  · Animal Age: 8-13 Weeks  · Animal Sex: Male  · Animal Strain: C57B6/J  · Number: 5 Mice  · Groups:  o Fibroblasts Cultured Alone  § With and Without 100ng/mL LPS Stimulation  o Bone marrow derived macrophages alone  § With and Without 100ng/mL LPS Stimulation  o Bone Marrow Derived Macrophages co-cultured with Fibroblasts  § With and Without 100ng/mL LPS Stimulation  o Bone Marrow Derived Macrophages Cultured on Transwell plate with Fibroblasts on Bottom Plate  § With and Without 100ng/mL LPS Stimulation  o Peritoneal Macrophages alone  § With and Without 100ng/mL LPS Stimulation  o Peritoneal Macrophages co-cultured with Fibroblasts  § With and Without 100ng/mL LPS Stimulation  o Peritoneal Macrophages cultured on Transwell Plate with Fibroblasts on Bottom Plate  § With and Without 100ng/mL LPS Stimulation  · Experimental Conditions: Peritoneal fibroblasts, bone marrow derived macrophages, and peritoneal macrophages were all harvested from B6 mice. Fibroblasts were plated at 20,000 cells/well in AMCF media. After 24 hours, macrophages were plated at 30,000 cells/well either alone, on top of fibroblasts, or with transwell in BMDM media. 24-hours later, media removed and replaced with AMCF containing 100 ng/mL LPS. Cells were harvested after 16 hours and examined via qPCR.   Licenses:  N/A
